title: Entropy-Minimizing Diffeomorphisms on a $G_2$-Manifold
summary: In this paper, we construct infinitely many diffeomorphisms of a Joyce manifold $M$ which achieve Yomdin's homological lower bound for topological entropy, imitating a recent construction of Farb-Looijenga for K3 surfaces. Moreover, following a recent paper by Crowley-Goette-Hertl, we show these diffeomorphisms act freely on a connected component of the Teichmüller space of $G_2$ structures on $M$, and hence that the homotopy moduli space of $G_2$ structures on $M$ has infinite fundamental group.
